configs.name: 旧入门 · 75%随机+25%一手启发式

protocol.baseline: Exact pre-model browser 75% legal-random/25% top-three one-ply heuristic; seed=(ply+1)*7919; no book
protocol.selection: Low-Elo model only: direct policy argmax or one-ply value argmax with pass-aware actor perspective. D4 mean; no book, MCTS, heuristic, noise or terminal override
protocol.limits: 50 paired-color screening/confirmation games; internal Elo is not official; no human win-rate or statistical significance claim
